Each five Class A shares becomes one; the split changes share count, not holders’ proportional ownership, except for fractional-share cash payments.
The share count contracts mechanically; this does not itself change equity value or improve business fundamentals.
Aims to regain Nasdaq's $1.00 bid-price compliance
The stated purpose is continued-listing compliance; the release does not establish that compliance will be regained or maintained.

This is a listing-compliance action, not a change to the company’s operating results or proportional ownership. The next catalyst is whether TruGolf regains and maintains Nasdaq’s minimum bid-price compliance.
